notes.title: Update notes for May 22, 2025
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, thanks for supporting my project, Blue Hill Wendigo. The first patch is up. The updates and fixes are as follows:

1. Can choose two gameplay modes: Casual or Experienced. 

* Casual gameplay mode: Higher damage to enemies while shooting. Easier gameplay. Trap (set by player) does not affect player (does affect enemies).
* Experienced gameplay mode: Low damage to enemies compared to casual mode. Slightly difficult gameplay. Trap affects both players and enemies. 

2. Graphics settings has two new options: Foliage quality and Resolution scale control. 

3. Damage to bandits has been improvised. 

4. Car steering improvement and improved space for driving. 

5. Fast travel options are provided for day time to explore unknown locations shown on map (Pls. note that fast travel is not available for night).

6. Extra video tutorials for easier understanding of required gameplay. 

7. Other minor bug fixes.
